rationale: Reviewed clean HEAD 33f1b924f1e1087e659edbe736f10681d0153db3 against recorded run base 04c9783874d88ca37a994e5a5448f6e6c2ef5d71: complete diff contains exactly eight approved paths, no mode/deletion/gitlink changes. Approved proposal, requirement and scope hashes match; all submitted document/source hashes and evidence source commits match. smbr-01: reproduced actual loader assembly and refusal/transfer fixtures; exact retained SPL, BL31/DT/default environment, three-option effective config and linked ELF-to-FIT checks pass. Pinned same-command-source sandbox logs and hashes match good/bad SHA and CRC semantics. Reported 319037904 logical bytes/417 MiB isolated scratch is within 512 MiB; loader endpoint and streaming preservation bounds remain enforced. smbr-04: native actual-finalizer both-mode/status/failure-return checks and ARM64 compilation pass. QMP evidence hashes, init/initrd/serial artifacts and guest RESET for PASS versus SHUTDOWN for FAILED_FINAL_ENV match; full writer diff changes only finish, leaving admission, claims, marker consumption, environment-last transfer and full readback unchanged. All 36 focused checks passed without skips; local Markdown links, diff checks and lock/indexed gitlinks pass. Material unmet smbr-02/smbr-03 capture constraint: scripts/sv08_serial_boot_route.py:161-166 opens/persists the fresh capture only after routing. Disposable entrypoint reproduction with an existing capture file emitted all six transmissions including source ${scriptaddr}, then raised FileExistsError, preserving only prior bytes and losing the new transcript. Unwritable/full/short-write capture failures likewise cannot gate source; no production entrypoint capture fault tests cover this. Reserve a fresh O_EXCL capture before opening serial or transmitting, persist bounded received data during the session, stop before further commands/source when persistence fails, retain available capture on refusal, and add focused entrypoint tests for existing/unwritable paths and mid-session write/fsync failure. Physical new-loader SD boot/MMC mapping, RTC retention, p5/full-write and automatic H616 return remain explicit separately reviewed H12 dependencies; offline results certify neither a hardware profile nor release.
